positive: Known actual JSON_CONSOLE output is captured privately with original encoder/filter retained; no synthetic app events or generic appender framework.
Existing25 case names preserved; original success requests/results/authority and model-free replay assertions retained.
Actual authenticated SSE, actuator HTTP scrape and public cache API are used; no fabricated sink bytes.
Only three known root Chromium links are inventoried; all other encountered links fail.
C4 fault windows remain honestly open; no new supporting E2E obligations.

findings.issue: publicCall retains an existing status assertion description containing response.body(). With C5 active, a leaked canary or credential in an unexpected response can reach JUnit/public logs before the private scan.
findings.minimumFix: For active C5, scan captured body privately and use a fixed status/path-only description before the original status/parser assertion; never format raw body into failure text. Preserve original behavior outside active C5 if desired.

findings.issue: Profile scan lstat/realpath checks are followed by readFileSync(child), which can follow a replaced symlink. NOFOLLOW applies to checks, not the actual file open.
findings.minimumFix: Open each profile file with O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW, fstat the opened descriptor against the checked regular-file dev/ino/bounds and read that descriptor; close in finally. Keep known links entry/target-text only, never follow. No new adversarial test family required.

findings.issue: watchExecution acquires an InputStream before status/content-type assertions; a rejected response throws before registration in streams, so finally cannot close it.
findings.minimumFix: Close the response InputStream if registration/status/media validation fails. Preserve authentic SSE and existing selected success checks.

cleanupNote: Restore logger levels while the private stream still owns output, then restore original stream; keep private known-value-file cleanup in a finally that runs even if restoration fails. This avoids an unnecessary TRACE forwarding interval.
requiredNext: Coordinator preflights minimal same-file repairs and freezes updated source; root rechecks only these deltas before existing focused first+ninth gate. No added support scenarios/frameworks.
